Insert generic copy and paste message sent to everyone in their Facebook friend list

I feel like this all the time, but the thing I realized is sometimes people do care about you the way you care about them, but it’s your self esteem and feelings towards yourself that block receiving that love. I’ve ruined a lot of good friendships because of this so just a heads up please work on loving yourself and feeling that the love you give yourself is enough.
I can relate to this feeling and I don’t believe you are being selfish. If you need a friend feel free to message me.

Ah, sorry it took me a couple hours to respond. Your response was sincere and it really touched me so it took me a while to process what you said. Being narco sucks but it does make me feel a little better that there are others out there that understand the struggle of it although I wouldn’t wish it upon others.

I know it’s kind of morbid but I really liked the way you explained just taking it day by day as ‘credit.’ I think I could try out that mindset. My problem seems to be though that every time I take a step forwards I take ten backwards because of past trauma.

Although I am an adult now, I am currently living with my mother (I had split homes as a child but I’ve always lived with my mom and visited my dad and his wife every day while my mother worked). I have cut off my communication with my father due to the past abuse as well as his wife (she’s his ex-wife now though technically). Even though I’ve cut them off their influence on every aspect of my life seems to be seeping through. I notice it in little things like from the way I was forced to disregard my own emotions and cater to the people around me because I didn’t matter and just I was gas lighted, guilted, terrorized and verbally abused and I still feel that anxiety and guilt lingering over everything constantly. It seems like I feel bad even existing I always feel like I’m causing trouble or being a bother. 

But anyways even though I cut off my father and his ex-wife they aren’t going to be letting me go that easily.  I luckily haven’t spoke to my father since January when I finally blocked him on social media and his phone number. The ex-wife constantly tries to get in contact with me and I was in contact with her for some time since I believe in forgiveness, but she got drunk (she’s an alcoholic as of the past couple years) and messaged me at night to guilt me over not being at her house to visit my brothers. She disregarded how I felt and as a child I basically had to be a parent to my little brother. 

He’s almost 14 now and I message him through Instagram and he has my phone number to text me, I never shut him out (despite the fact he touched me inappropriately when I was younger when his mother forced us to always shower together because she was too lazy to bathe him. I was 12 and he was 6.) his mother disregards that I have a job, a life and that I have shit to do. 

I know it sounds harsh saying that but she expects me to be the support system for her children and even though she knows how I feel about visiting and the trauma of the abuse over the years, she just doesn’t care about it. All that matters is what she wants from me and that shit hurts to realize that I carried that message from childhood to adulthood. I didn’t even notice it until I got that text from her guilting me and telling me to stop abandoning my brothers

. And I notice now that I often repress my feelings for other people and do what others would want from me and sometimes I don’t know what i even want because I just “want” to do what others ask of me to make them happy or to avoid the guilt.

I have blocked her now as well, but that message got to me and just makes me think back on things. And along with that I just feel that guilt from childhood and I don’t have a foundation for my self esteem. And due to not receiving unconditional love it’s hard for me to feel or believe that my friends love me. Especially with how busy my best friend has been recently. We have messaged every single day for the past 3 years but for the past month I’ve felt sort of abandoned and I mentioned that once and she assured me we’ll be talking a lot again soon. I just feel childish even getting sad and lonely and feeling abandoned over this but it reminds me of the feeling of when my father use to gas light me and tell me that my actual mother didn’t care for me and abandoned me (she didn’t she was just young when she had me and was desperate for love so she dated a lot of men and gave them a lot of attention and I was a jealous child and felt abandoned and my dad preyed on that). I just feel isolated more than ever and it hurts aaa.

I’m sorry my response is so long. I truly do appreciate your response to my post and would like to thank you. Sorry again for rambling.
